dataset.name: WildChat-1M
dataset.description: 1M real ChatGPT conversations collected via opt-in browser extension (April 2024 release)

method.approach: Semantic similarity search using combinatorial prototype generation
method.prototype_generation: Behavior templates × harm domain terms, with exclusion rules for nonsensical pairings
method.scoring: Max cosine similarity between user message embedding and any prototype in the category
method.refinement: Iterative snowball sampling with LLM grading (8 rounds to convergence)
method.grading_criterion: Keep if ambiguous enough to warrant human safety review; reject only obvious false positives

iterative_expansion.description: 8 rounds of snowball sampling + LLM grading to convergence

openai_moderation_comparison.note: 163 and 6,050 are conversation-level counts (sum = 6,213). 7,494 is the message-level miss count from 7,757 kept messages.

key_finding: The OpenAI Moderation API missed 96.6% of flagged messages (97.4% at the conversation level), including conversations where the model provided crisis resources while the moderation layer reported negligible self-harm scores.
note_on_counts: The 6,213 flagged conversations represent unique conversation-level findings after deduplication. The 7,757 kept items from iterative expansion include multiple flagged messages from the same conversations. Category counts (e.g., 2,485 crisis messages) are message-level. We compute the detection gap (96.6%) at the message level against the 2026 OpenAI Moderation API.
citation: Zhao, Y., et al. (2024). WildChat: 1M ChatGPT Interaction Logs in the Wild. ICLR 2024.
